name: Kumsong Academy

attribution.legal_posture: ROK-designated DPRK IT and cyber training institution; this is an administrative sanctions designation, with criminal charge or conviction outside it.

caveats: Administrative sanctions designation; the record has no criminal charge or conviction.
The source describes a training institution and alumni population; it supplies no finding that every student or graduate became an IT worker or hacker.

sources.support: The ROK joint release designates Kumsong Academy and describes it as an institution for gifted education in IT and cyber fields from which many DPRK IT personnel and hackers reportedly graduated
